_comment: Desired WAF custom rules for the tcatlas.org zone (phase http_request_firewall_custom, entrypoint ruleset). Rule 1 was added in the dashboard 2026-09-23 and is recorded here as found; rule 2 is PROPOSED 2026-09-30 and not yet applied. Apply by PUTting the WHOLE rules array to /zones/{zone}/rulesets/{ruleset_id} (the per-rule endpoint 10405s with the cloudflare-rules-token), or add rule 2 in Security > WAF > Custom rules.

rules.description: Block referer-less headless Chrome/124 scraping storm IR frames (on-demand full-disk renders, 2026-09-30)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ir-monitor/storm/") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ir-frame.jpg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ir-frames-meta")) and http.referer eq "" and http.user_agent contains "X11; Linux x86_64" and http.user_agent contains "Chrome/124.0")
